text.brief: A pastor in Flushing learns in 2043 that a mainland police app shows his congregation to officers in Fujian, ranked by risk. The names of each member's relatives on the mainland sit beside every face.
text.record: Freedom House named the Party the most prolific perpetrator of transnational repression, with 22 percent of recorded physical incidents from 2014 through 2024. The Justice Department charged two men in April 2023 with running an undeclared police station for the Party in Manhattan. Leaked Xinjiang police files in 2022 showed registries that tracked families and travel in detail.
text.reading: The Party points at the few it punishes to warn the many it watches. An AI registry links every diaspora member to relatives at home, and one public case teaches millions to stay quiet. This is Stratagem 26, point at the mulberry while cursing the locust.
text.coreEvent: Investigators document a Party AI system that profiles more than ten million people of Chinese descent outside the mainland before 2045.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. The Party joins data on people abroad to their relatives at home, and no American law stops the join.
text.fix: Bar the transfer of diaspora data to the Party's systems and punish every act of coercion that uses it.
